LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.0.label: Suppression Rhythm
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.0.descripti: Requires Suppression Pulse learned from its augment card. Retains original damage, stun duration, range and cooldown. Later nodes require this skill to actually increase the target’s remaining stun time; immunity or a stun that does not extend the existing one grants nothing.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.1.label: Pinned Opening
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.1.descripti: When Suppression Pulse actually increases stun time, mark that enemy for 6 seconds. One mark, created once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that target consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Hitting another enemy does not consume it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.2.label: Suppression Barrier
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.2.descripti: When Suppression Pulse actually increases stun time, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Existing shield modifiers still apply. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.3.label: Opening Burst
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.3.descripti: After your Pinned Opening bonus deals damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. It never strikes the original target again and applies no stun. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.4.label: Opening Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.4.descripti: After your Pinned Opening bonus deals damage, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.5.label: Suppression Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.5.descripti: When Suppression Pulse actually increases stun time, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.6.label: Disabling Aid
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Bind015.nodes.6.descripti: When Suppression Pulse actually increases stun time, heal 20 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. With no injured ally, it does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
